scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @fieldsync/server && npm run build -w @fieldsync/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/sync-core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test:unit -w @fieldsync/sync-core && npm test -w @fieldsync/server && npm test -w @fieldsync/web
scripts.load: npm run build:core && npm run load -w @fieldsync/server
